body.name: \(\mathrm{CI}_n\)
body.def: \(\mathrm{CI}_n=[\max\{0,\widehat\theta_{L,n}-c_{n,1-\alpha}/\sqrt n\},\min\{1,\max\{0,\widehat\theta_{U,n}+c_{n,1-\alpha}/\sqrt n\}\}]\); if the displayed lower endpoint exceeds the upper endpoint under an off-support finite-sample realization, set \(\mathrm{CI}_n=\{0\}\).
body.role: confidence interval for the entire sharp identified set
